issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the problem statement's UML declares this method as public (+getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int) in problem_statement.md, but the solution implementation in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java declares it as protected (protected int getTotalNumberOfStudents()). This visibility difference is a real contradiction that can confuse students about the intended API and may cause external tests or usage outside the package to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Preferred fix: change the solution method signature to public (public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()) so the implementation matches the UML and problem text. Alternatively, if protected visibility is intentional, update the UML and problem statement to show protected visibility and adjust the template and any tests to expect protected access.
